mapper.select: select id as id, user_id as userId, question as question, answer as answer, source as source, processed as processed, created_at as createTime from question_log where user_id = #{username} order by created_at desc

select id, user_id as userId, title, content, images, view_count as viewCount, like_count as likeCount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from forum_post where user_id = #{username} order by created_at desc

select fl.id as id, fl.post_id as postId, fl.created_at as createdAt, fp.title as postTitle from forum_like fl left join forum_post fp on fl.post_id = fp.id where fl.user_id = #{username} order by fl.created_at desc

select fc.id as id, fc.post_id as postId, fc.content as content, fc.created_at as createdAt, fp.title as postTitle from forum_comment fc left join forum_post fp on fc.post_id = fp.id where fc.user_id = #{username} order by fc.created_at desc
